title: Ethanol (C₂H₅OH) — The Hydroxyl Group
description: Examine alcohols, the polar -OH functional group, and its profound effect on properties.

steps.prompt: Ethanol has a 2-carbon ethane chain attached to an -OH group. What functional group gives it alcoholic properties?
steps.explanation: Correct! The -OH group is called the hydroxyl functional group, classifying the molecule as an alcohol.

steps.prompt: Look closely at the oxygen atom connecting the carbon chain to the terminal hydrogen. Notice its bent C-O-H geometry (108.5°).
steps.explanation: Just like in water, oxygen in ethanol has two non-bonding lone pairs that bend the C-O-H angle.

steps.prompt: Why is ethanol completely miscible with water while ethane gas is insoluble?
options: The polar -OH group forms intermolecular hydrogen bonds with water
steps.explanation: The strongly electronegative oxygen atom creates a polar O-H bond capable of forming hydrogen bonds with neighboring water molecules.
